story_type: yacht sinking stern first, 13 people taken off by cutter
hook: 13 people got off. 25 minutes later, it sank.
narration: This yacht was going under off the Florida coast.
Thirteen people were aboard the Serena III, thirteen nautical miles off Lauderdale-by-the-Sea.
The Coast Guard Cutter Margaret Norvell came alongside.
This is infrared footage. It shows heat, so engines, hulls and people stand out from the cooler sea.
The cutter launched its small boat crew beside the listing yacht.
They took all thirteen people off.
[short pause] About twenty five minutes later, the yacht slid under, stern first.
outcome: The Margaret Norvell crew rescued all thirteen people from the Serena III before she sank.
title: Yacht sank 25 minutes after rescue
description:
On Jan. 25, 2016, the crew of Coast Guard Cutter Margaret Norvell rescued 13 people from the 103-foot yacht Serena III, 13 nautical miles off Lauderdale-by-the-Sea, Florida.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Miami, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/447347
